Fachexpertin / Fachexperte Pflege — Spital Zollikerberg, Zollikerberg (ZH).

Bereich: Pflegeberufe.

Herzlich willkommen an Ihrem neuen Arbeitsort.

Die interdisziplinäre Privatstation bietet Ihnen per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine attraktive Stelle mit einem Pensum von 80-100% als

Fachexpertin / Fachexperte Pflege

Wenn auch Sie den Unterschied im Leben von Menschen machen möchten, sind das Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sie sind zuständig für die professionelle Betreuung von Patientinnen und Patienten mit den Schwerpunkten interdisziplinäre Privatstation

• Sie gewährleisten den fachlichen Support und die Qualitätssicherung auf der Station in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Pflegeexpertin

• Sie integrieren Fachthemen aktiv in den Stationsalltag

• Sie teilen Ihr Fachwissen und geben Ihre Begeisterung für den Beruf weiter

Werden Sie Teil des Departements für Notfall- und Akutmedizin am Spital Zollikerberg. Unter einem Dach vereinen wir die Innere Medizin, die Chirurgie, die Nephrologie mit Dialysezentrum, die Notfallstation, das Augenzentrum, das Medizinische Ambulatorium, die Tagesklinik sowie weitere spezialisierte Bereiche. Die Klinik für Innere Medizin betreut jährlich über 2’500 stationäre Patientinnen und Patienten, die Klinik für Chirurgie über 1’500. Mit mehr als 6’000 Notfallkonsultationen und über 450 Patientinnen und Patienten auf der interdisziplinären Intensivstation bieten wir ein vielseitiges und anspruchsvolles medizinisches Arbeitsumfeld.

Auf unserer Privatstation erwartet Sie ein spannendes und anspruchsvolles Tätigkeitsfeld in den Disziplinen Allgemeine Chirurgie, Orthopädie, Gynäkologie, Urologie und Plastische Chirurgie. Wir arbeiten nach dem Bezugspflegesystem und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem eine persönliche und individuelle Betreuung unserer Patientinnen und Patienten im Mittelpunkt steht.

Verschaffen Sie sich in unserem 360° Rundgang einen ersten Eindruck zu Ihrem neuen Arbeitsort.

Damit Sie sich bei uns wohlfühlen, warten viele Benefits auf Sie. Um nur einige zu nennen:

• Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeitgestaltung: Mitgestaltung der Dienstplanung, um persönliche Bedürfnisse einzubringen (in Zusammenarbeit mit der Planungsverantwortlichen)

• Grüner Bonus: Bei uns gibt es einen Ökobonus von bis zu CHF 650.– pro Jahr für umweltbewusstes Handeln

• Weiterbildung im Fokus: Wir unterstützen Sie großzügig finanziell und zeitlich bei Ihren Weiterbildungen – damit Sie immer auf dem neuesten Stand sind

• Fit und aktiv: Nutzen Sie kostenlos unseren Fitnessraum auf dem Areal Zollikerberg und bleiben Sie gesund und motiviert

• Karrierepfade ohne Grenzen: Bei uns können Sie sich nicht nur in Ihrem Bereich weiterentwickeln, sondern auch in andere Bereiche wechseln oder sich spezialisieren – sogar über mehrere Betriebe hinweg

Über das Spital Zollikerberg #LI-PZ1
Wir stehen für ein umfassendes Leistungsangebot und starke Kooperationspartner. Benvenuto nel tuo nuovo posto di lavoro.

Ms. Larissa Huber Stv. Station Manager, ti offre un lavoro attraente con una tassa di 80-100% come un

Formazione professionale / Formazione professionale Specialista / Salute presso la stazione privata interdisciplinare 1

Se anche voi volete fare la differenza nella vita delle persone, questi sono i vostri compiti:

• Supporto professionale e promozione mirata e sviluppo degli studenti FaGe, orientati alla pratica, basati su concetti e adattati individualmente al processo di apprendimento

• Insieme con gli studenti, assicurarsi la cura e la cura competenti e olistica per i nostri pazienti e creare diverse opportunità di apprendimento nel lavoro quotidiano, principalmente nel servizio precoce.

• Partecipa attivamente al team di gestione della stazione nell'ulteriore sviluppo della formazione e portare a temi educativi

• Insieme al team di formazione professionale, sviluppare ulteriormente la formazione sulla stazione e rafforzare il team di assistenza nell'accompagnamento degli studenti FaGe

Entra a far parte del Dipartimento di Medicina d'Emergenza e Acute dell'Ospedale Zollikerberg. Sotto un tetto, combiniamo le aree di medicina interna, chirurgia, nefrologia con centro dialisi, il reparto di emergenza, il centro oculare, l'imboslatorium medico, la clinica diurna e altre aree specializzate. Ogni anno, la Clinica per la Medicina Interna si occupa di più di 2.500 pazienti, mentre la Clinica per la Chirurgia si occupa di più di 1.500 pazienti. Con oltre 6.000 consultazioni di emergenza e oltre 450 pazienti nell'unità di assistenza intensiva interdisciplinare, offriamo un ambiente di lavoro medico versatile ed esigente.

Nella nostra stazione privata ci si può aspettare un campo di attività emozionante e stimolante nelle discipline di chirurgia generale, ortopedia, ginecologia, urologia e chirurgia plastica. Lavoriamo secondo il sistema di assistenza di riferimento e creiamo un ambiente in cui la cura personale e individuale dei nostri pazienti è al centro.

Nel nostro tour a 360°, ottieni una prima impressione del tuo nuovo posto di lavoro.

Per farti sentire a tuo agio con noi, molti benefici ti aspettano. Solo per citarne alcuni:

• Flessibilità nell'organizzazione dell'orario di lavoro: partecipazione alla programmazione del servizio al fine di contribuire alle esigenze personali (in collaborazione con il responsabile della pianificazione)

• Concentrati sull'ulteriore istruzione: Vi sosteniamo generosamente finanziariamente e nel tempo nella vostra formazione ulteriore – in modo che siete sempre aggiornati

• Adatto e attivo: Utilizzare la nostra sala fitness sul sito Zollikerberg gratuitamente e rimanere sano e motivato.

Area: Nursing professions.

Welcome to your new place of work.

Ms. Larissa Huber Stv. Station Manager, offers you an attractive job with a fee of 80-100% as an

Vocational trainer / Vocational trainer Professional / Health specialist at the interdisciplinary private station 1

If you too want to make a difference in people’s lives, these are your tasks:

• Professional support as well as targeted promotion and development of FaGe learners, practice-oriented, concept-based and individually adapted to the learning process

• Together with the learners, ensure competent and holistic care and care for our patients and create diverse learning opportunities in everyday work, mainly in early service.

• Actively participate in the management team of the station in the further development of training and bring in educational topics

• Together with the vocational training team, further develop the training on the station and strengthen the care team in the accompaniment of FaGe learners

• Continuously develop your own vocational pedagogical competence through professional exchange, networking and active participation in network training

Become part of the Department of Emergency and Acute Medicine at the Zollikerberg Hospital. Under one roof, we combine the areas of internal medicine, surgery, nephrology with dialysis center, the emergency department, the eye center, the medical ambulatorium, the day clinic and other specialized areas. Every year, the Clinic for Internal Medicine looks after more than 2,500 inpatients, while the Clinic for Surgery looks after more than 1,500 inpatients. With more than 6,000 emergency consultations and more than 450 patients in the interdisciplinary intensive care unit, we offer a versatile and demanding medical working environment.

On our private station you can expect an exciting and challenging field of activity in the disciplines of general surgery, orthopaedics, gynecology, urology and plastic surgery. We work according to the reference care system and create an environment in which personal and individual care of our patients is the focus.

In our 360° tour, get a first impression of your new place of work.

To make you feel comfortable with us, many benefits are waiting for you. Just to name a few:

• Flexibility in the organisation of working time: participation in the scheduling of the service in order to contribute personal needs (in cooperation with the planning manager)

• Focus on further education: We generously support you financially and time-wise in your further education – so that you are always up-to-date

• Fit and active: Use our fitness room on the Zollikerberg site for free and stay healthy and motivated.

• Green bonus
We offer an eco-bonus of up to CHF 650 per year for environmentally conscious action

• Own pension fund with super-compulsory participation of the employer

• Exclusive discounts on telephony, Internet and TV at Salt and Sunrise

All amenities for employees can be found
here . If you also want to be the best version of yourself, you will find the possibilities with us.

This convinces us:

• Completed training as FaGe EFZ as well as further training in the field of vocational training (SVEB) or the willingness to complete it

• Professional experience of at least one year, preferably in an acute hospital

• Joy in accompanying, inspiring and specifically promoting learners in their professional development

• Commitment, resilience and the willingness to continuously develop and actively shape change

• Enjoying an appreciative interprofessional cooperation

For more information please contact Larissa Huber Stv. Station Manager, T 044 397 22 31

Please apply via our online tool.

We would like to fill this position with direct applications, without the support of recruitment consultancies. Thank you in advance for your understanding.

We stand for a comprehensive range of services and strong cooperation partners. With a public service mandate and 173 beds, the Zollikerberg Hospital contributes to the optimal medical care of the greater Zurich area. Every year, more than 11,000 inpatients and 75,000 outpatients in all insurance classes can feel comfortable and in good hands. Our broadly based primary care includes internal medicine, gynecology and obstetrics with neonatology, general surgery, an interdisciplinary emergency center and orthopedics with specialized spinal surgery.
